Vivral (Nair Engineering) | ML, Systems (GPU), Hardware, and Embedded Engineers | Gainesville, FL (UF students) | Part-time | Equity

Vivral is an AI health assistant that helps people understand their health. We run frontier-grade medical AI on ordinary computers instead of the cloud, so health support can reach remote, underserved communities. Already tested by researchers at UF, Michigan, and Princeton.

We're hiring part-time student engineers (sophomores through PhD): Machine Learning (PyTorch, LLMs), Systems (CUDA/Triton, making large models run fast on everyday hardware), Hardware (FPGA, digital design), and Embedded (C/C++ firmware). Roles are built around class schedules and come with equity that vests over time.

Apply (10 minutes): https://forms.gle/PrewX9oGEj7fCMR46 More: nairengineering.com
